comment: Runs 001-008 (review account, cites P-0025): A-B pair at rest, two particles, r0 inside [4.0, 8.0] (4.01, 4.5, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5, 7.99), horizontal, vertical and diagonal, one with B on the left. Judge-style RMSE/L of predict() against each run is 0.0050 to 0.0051, all eight below the bar 3 x 0.007 = 0.021. Verdict replicated on the stated error bound. The exponent 2.5 is not tested. This verdict covers the stated 0.007 bound only.
